5350.title: Pi worker restart: temporary extension path investigation
5350.rootCauseOneLine: The reported failure's cause is not established; current main rebuilds worker-local extension and tools paths, and real Pi resume and fork succeeded after deleting the previous worker root in two clean checkouts.
5350.proposedFix: No production change is justified yet. Next capture sanitized launch arguments, tools-file existence immediately before extension load, and worker lifecycle ordering for the failing packaged version on macOS.
5350.caveats: Checked Linux with the repository-pinned Pi 0.84.0, not the reported macOS/Pi 1.1.0 setup. Exercised trusted source worker and provider entry, not the historical packaged host artifact. This does not disprove the reported incident. Reproduction test and output are inline in the report.
